summary: Every legal input has exactly four fixed-width time endpoints drawn from one 1,440-minute day, so the contract has no growing workload dimension for runtime scaling.

workload_bound.source_constraint: event1 and event2 each contain exactly two valid same-day HH:MM strings of length five

replacement_checks.evidence: The Accepted source performs one maximum, one minimum, and one non-strict comparison over four strings whose lengths are fixed at five.
Regression verifies all 2,073,600 pairs of same-minute point events, every interval pair on a reduced ordered clock, and the full-day endpoints.
